verdict.rationale: Conductor's own docs show it runs third-party agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) inside its workspaces. Teams can configure per-organization connections to those agents and run them on schedules or via GitHub Actions. That covers integrating a fixed set of vendor-built agents, but nothing shows a partner app ecosystem, marketplace, or extension mechanism for plugging in arbitrary partner-built agent apps. Missing for 10: a documented partner or third-party agent app marketplace or plugin/SDK for adding new agent apps, support beyond the fixed list of named agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.
Configure cloud agent connections separately for each organization, and choose whether Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor use an API key or subscription.
Sign in to your Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces.
You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.
